- **E0573** (poem, sure): 中和堂. 嘉庆十七年 (1812) · v4 p.193, under 迎晖殿; source ref 5-138 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=196
  > 建极致中和，天地咸位育。大本慎操持，达道归善淑。宽猛相济之，机括互倚伏。中节无不宜，毋为情欲逐。修业必致诚，省衷义理复。率性偏倚消，能者斯养福。
  Poem 中和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1812, filed by the editors under 迎晖殿.
- **E0574** (poem, sure): 中和堂. 嘉庆十七年 (1812) · v4 p.193, under 迎晖殿; source ref 5-143 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=196
  > 至理贯於天地，民受其中以生。建极立政不倚，持心空鉴平衡。含和浃洽黎庶，定静可息纷争。操存一念毋懈，乾坤位育咸亨。
  Poem 中和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1812, filed by the editors under 迎晖殿.
- **E0575** (poem, sure): 中和堂. 嘉庆十九年 (1814) · v4 p.194, under 迎晖殿; source ref 5-344 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=197
  > 存心养性政敷宣，立极建中在不偏。六府孔修民自正，弼予图治望群贤。
  Poem 中和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 迎晖殿.
- **E0576** (poem, sure): 中和堂. 嘉庆十九年 (1814) · v4 p.194, under 迎晖殿; source ref 5-347 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=197

  Poem 中和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 迎晖殿.
- **E0577** (poem, sure): 中和堂. 嘉庆十九年 (1814) · v4 p.195, under 迎晖殿; source ref 6-046 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=198

  Poem 中和堂 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1814, filed by the editors under 迎晖殿.
- **E1011** (description, sure): Site status table, about 2011: nothing visible, or built over. c. 2011 · 系列06 repost, status table · S356. https://blog.sina.com.cn/s/blog_c27029650101itzz.html
  Same table. In it the first group shows no visible remains; 得全阁, 流香渚, 凤麟洲, 涵秋馆, 蔚藻堂, 中和堂, 敷春堂 and 心镜轩 have service buildings on them, and 含晖楼, 澄心堂, 延寿寺, 清夏堂 and 喜雨山房 are occupied by other institutions. 澹泊宁静 and several others have been dug since, so this is out of date for them.
- **E0524** (description, sure): 张宝章: Qichun Yuan under Jiaqing and Daoguang. 《圆明园研究》第32期 · sections 三, 四 · S224. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/ymyyj/yj032/201504/t20150420_693218.html
  Axis from the great gate in the south-east: 勤政殿, 中和堂, 敷春堂, up to 问月楼 on the lake shore. In the north a large water split by a causeway, with 凤麟洲 on an island in the east part; south of the small western lake 展诗应律, 庄严法界, 生冬室, 春泽斋, 四宜书屋. On two southern islands 畅和堂 and 绿满轩, with 澄心堂 between 畅和堂 and 正觉寺. This also gives QC09 庄严法界 a rough position (Q11).
- **E0506** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 绮春园. 2020 edition · v4 p.170 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=173
  Formed from princes' and ministers' gardens, about 54.3 ha. Taken back from Fuheng's heirs and renamed in 1769; gate, tiger-stone wall and 正觉寺 added by 1773, rebuilt in 1795. Jiaqing's growth came in three stages: the western and central groups of the Thirty Scenes first, then the new gate and eastern scenes, finally the south-west (招凉榭, 湛清轩, 畅和堂, 澄心堂, the shrines), gathered as a New Twenty Scenes.
- **E0572** (description, sure): 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 迎晖殿. 2020 edition · v4 p.193 · S361. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/xs/yjbg/202008/P020200803382796786124.pdf#page=196
  Called 勤政殿 under Jiaqing and begun in 1809 inside the south main gate; under Daoguang the dowager received birthday congratulations here, and two dowagers lay in state here. North of it is the seven-bay 中和堂, then the path past the hill to the dowager's quarters.
- **E0568** (description, sure, search index only): Palace front of Qichun Yuan. 2011 post · t20110105_231486 (search summary) · S227. https://www.yuanmingyuanpark.cn/cgll/zyjd/qcy/201101/t20110105_231486.html
  From the screen wall to the hill behind 中和堂: about 200 by 120 m. Built 1809 and called the new gate. Great and second gates are gate halls with rolled-ridge hip-and-gable roofs. 迎晖殿 is the main hall where the dowager took birthday homage. In 1986 the gates and walls were rebuilt on the site; the 迎晖殿 terrace remains.
- **E0590** (description, likely, search index only): 敷春堂; 澄心堂; 迎晖殿 and 中和堂 labels; 绮春 四宜书屋 (search-index text). n.d. · mhymy ysltd 12232, 7496, 13985 · S340. https://www.mhymy.com/dasl/ysltd/7496.html
  敷春堂: the dowagers' residence from Daoguang, inside the south gate, with a stage per the archives. 澄心堂: island, five-bay hall with side halls. A plan labels 中和堂新宫门 and 迎辉殿. 四宜书屋 built 1805, west of 生冬室.
- **E0578** (drawing, sure): 绮春园寝宫区总平面图. 道光三十年 (1850) 八月二十四日 · 清华大学建筑学院 PpXXI11-7号 · S310. https://www.mhymy.com/dasl/ysltd/7521.html
